newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Rep. offers 13-week T-bills at 12.6 percent.
newsitem.headline: Czech Rep. offers 13-week T-bills at 12.6 percent.

text.p: The Czech National Bank on Wednesday set a Dutch auction for Thursday offering 13-week finance ministry treasury bills.
Maximum acceptable gross yield on bids was set at 12.6 percent, the central bank said.
Five billion crowns will be offered at the auction, it said.
Bids are due at the central bank by 1200 CET on Thursday (1100 GMT).
Gross yield in the CNB's last auction of 13-week treasury bills in mid-December was 11.5 percent, but that was before taxation on treasury bills took effect at the beginning of January.
Dealers have been expecting the finance ministry and central bank to adjust the limit price on the auctions because of the new tax conditions.
With the new tax, the maximum acceptable net yield on bids is 9.45 percent, the CNB said.
